It brought us into the streets more than 8 years ago and birthed #BlackLivesMatter. 

Today is another reminder that we’re far from achieving our abolitionist future. But rest assured, we will get there. We will win. #EndWhiteSupremacy

The courts can only uphold but a minimum standard, if that, of what it truly means to honor the sacred worth of all Black lives. Ahmaud should be alive. We continue to mourn with his family and rejoice with them for this semblance of justice.
#AhmaudArbery #BlackLivesMatter

For 7 years #BlackLivesMatter has been drawing connections between white-supremacist-capitalism & police violence with our #BlackXmas campaign. 
Read more on why we must #BuildBlack #BuyBlack & #BankBlack in this @thelasentinel piece by @DocMellyMel.
